title: Ohmic n-type bars: exact Ohm's law and velocity saturation by a field-dependent mobility (analytic)
description:
Two n-type silicon bars (N_D = 1e23 1/m^3, n_i 1e16, 2 um long, two 5 nm cells high each) separated by a one-cell insulating gap (n_intrinsic 0, so no current crosses it), each with its own ohmic contacts on the outer 20 nm: anode at V_bias on x_lo, cathode at 0 V on x_hi. Bar a has the constant mobility mu0 = 0.135; bar b the state-dependent velocity-saturation mobility mu_n = mu0 / (1 + mu0 |E_x| / v_sat) (v_sat = 1e5 m/s), which reads the bar's own field semiconductor_E_x (a DynamicMaterialUpdate: the stationary study iterates it; the second solve already reproduces the first potential, so it converges in two iterations). The innermost contact cell of bar b sees only half the face field (its other face lies inside the contact, cell-centre E_x is the mean of the two faces), so its contact pads carry a twin material with 2 |E_x|: every current-carrying face of bar b then has mu(E) and its potential stays exactly linear like bar a's (both bars stay at one potential, no field in the gap). The insulating gap spans only the free part of the bars: under the contacts the gap row belongs to bar a's pads (doped silicon held at the contact voltage), so the gap potential is linear like the bars'. An insulating cell between two held contact cells beside one carrying the linear drop would bend the potential at the contact edge (a fringe field charging the bars there; ~1e-3 at 5 V). Stationary sweep V_bias = 0.25..5 V.
Analytic (Scharfetter-Gummel is exact for uniform carriers): the drop starts at the centres of the innermost held contact cells, L_eff = Lx - 2 w_contact + dx = 1.965 um, E = V_bias / L_eff; I = q h (V_bias / L_eff) (mu n0 + mu_p p0) per m of depth with n0 = N_D / 2 + sqrt(N_D^2 / 4 + n_i^2), p0 = n_i^2 / n0 (holes: 4e-15 of the total) and mu = mu0 (bar a) or mu0 / (1 + mu0 E / v_sat) (bar b).
Derived values tab: I_ohmic (bar a anode current, scalar output semiconductor_current_anode_a, exact to ~1e-7: float32 material arrays), I_saturated (bar b, likewise ~1e-7), I_cathode_b (= -I_saturated), saturation_ratio = I_b / I_a against the mobility factor 1 / (1 + mu0 E / v_sat) (0.85 at 0.25 V, 0.23 at 5 V) and v_drift = Jn_x / (q N) over the free part of bar b against mu E (approaches v_sat).
Sweep tab: the five derived values versus V_bias with their dashed curves (I_ohmic a straight line, I_saturated bending over toward q n0 h v_sat = 16 A/m).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 5 V): V_line along bar b, linear from V_bias + psi_bulk to psi_bulk between the innermost contact cell centres (psi_bulk = V_T asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) = 0.417 V). Field tab: V, E_x, N, Jn_x.

parameters.name: V_bias
parameters.description: anode voltage in V of both bars, cathodes at 0 V (the sweep runs 0.25..5 V)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: k_B
parameters.description: Boltzmann constant in J/K

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: V_T
parameters.description: thermal voltage in V (25.85 mV)

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of silicon (also the gap)

parameters.name: N_D
parameters.description: donor density of both bars in 1/m^3

parameters.name: mu0
parameters.description: low-field electron mobility in m^2/(V s)

parameters.name: mu_h
parameters.description: hole mobility in m^2/(V s) (constant in both bars)

parameters.name: v_sat
parameters.description: electron saturation velocity in m/s of bar b

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: bar length along x

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: h_bar
parameters.description: height of each bar (two cells: a 1D problem)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height: bar a, a one-cell gap, bar b

parameters.name: y_b0
parameters.description: lower edge of bar b

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of each ohmic contact at the bar ends

parameters.name: x_anode_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held anode cell

parameters.name: x_cathode_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held cathode cell

parameters.name: L_eff
parameters.description: length of the voltage drop in m (1.965 um)

parameters.name: E_ref
parameters.description: uniform field magnitude in the bars in V/m

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: neutral electron density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: p0
parameters.description: neutral hole density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: psi_bulk
parameters.description: neutral potential V_T asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) in V (0.417 V)

parameters.name: mu_sat
parameters.description: field-dependent electron mobility of bar b at E_ref in m^2/(V s)

parameters.name: I_ohmic_ref
parameters.description: analytic current of bar a in A/m

parameters.name: I_sat_ref
parameters.description: analytic current of bar b in A/m

parameters.name: ratio_ref
parameters.description: current ratio bar b / bar a (the mobility factor)

parameters.name: v_drift_ref
parameters.description: electron drift speed in bar b in m/s
